description_en: Updates the information about a virtual resource group
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-virtual-resource --cluster-id cn-hangzhou --virtual-resource-id eas-vr-npovr28onap1xxxxxx --resources QuotaId=quota185lqf994k6 ResourceId=eas-r-g55ieatgg3butwrn7a Priority=6 Region=cn-hangzhou SpotPriceLimit=10.05 InstanceType=ecs.s6-c1m2.xlarge --virtual-resource-name NewMyVirtualResource --disable-spot-protection-period true --region cn-hangzhou
